methods.name: Exact reducible critical gauge, characteristic root-activity and first Newton-edge calculus
capabilities: construct one exact global rational strict powered-gauge representative
collapse representative branch ratios into gauge-invariant characteristic exponential layers
select the first root-active strict layer when the selected Perron root is simple
compute selected-root multiplicity and strict-layer contact orders exactly
compare candidate radical scales by rational integer powers
return first Newton-edge state and a rational edge polynomial when the selected root is rational
methods.core_law: Reducible critical branch ratios are representative-dependent, but closed characteristic ratio layers are gauge invariant. Simple selected roots use root activity; multiple selected roots use contact-order-weighted Newton scales.
methods.hard_boundary: This tool does not claim canonical reducible per-edge ratios, a full Puiseux series, a floating eigensolver, signed/amplitude semantics or infinite-state coverage.
